The following SQL will update the ContactName to "Juan" for ALL records:

### Code Snippets

```
UPDATE Customers
SET ContactName = 'Alfred Schmidt', City= 'Frankfurt'
WHERE CustomerID = 1;

---

UPDATE Customers
SET ContactName='Juan'
WHERE Country='Mexico';

---

UPDATE Customers
SET ContactName='Juan';
```
